name: Mithral Armor

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: No Strength requirement and no Disadvantage on Stealth checks.
text: Made of light, supple mithral, this armor drops any Strength requirement and any Disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks that the ordinary version of the armor would have.
